reviews.title: Works Well In The Garage
reviews.body: My yard backs up against a neighbor's cow pasture so flies are just part of the deal around here. Apparently his flies do not respect property lines.  ;)  I hang these in my garage near the cat food and they do a good job keeping the flies under control.They are the usual sticky fly strips so you do have to be a little careful handling them. Once they are up though they work fine and catch flies pretty quickly. The pack comes with a ton of them too so I do not feel like I have to ration them. For the price and how long they last this is a pretty good deal. I would buy them again when I run out becuase they do exactly what I need.

reviews.title: TOO sticky
reviews.body: Let me preface this by saying that as a horse owner, I’ve used pretty much every fly deterrent and trap out there. I bought these because they’re cheap. And yes, they DO work, very well - but I’ve had the canister come off on several; as soon as you try to pull the tape out, it pops out of the tube still coiled, and now it’s useless. See picture. Also, the loop you pull to get the tape out, is incredibly sticky - and shouldn’t be that way. It’s really irritating setting up a few fly strips and having your hands be coated with the stickiness because the loop is sticky.So yeah, while they do work well, I don’t like getting my hands sticky putting them up, and also don’t like the fact several have been wasted. I’d rather pay more for another brand to not have the sticky stuff over my hands.

reviews.title: Works great on flies, but a little messy to handle
reviews.body: I picked these up during a late summer fly invasion, and they do the job exactly as advertised. The sticky surface is strong enough to catch houseflies, gnats, and even a couple of fruit flies that wandered too close. Once they’re up, you can see the difference in just a day or two.A few things to know:The strips are very sticky — which is great for catching bugs, but tricky when unrolling. I had one fold on itself, and once that happens, it’s not salvageable.The included thumbtacks make hanging easy, but they’re awkward to remove from the tube without getting your fingers sticky.They aren’t the most attractive décor item (let’s be real, sticky ribbons of trapped flies never are), but for garages, porches, and kitchens, they’re effective.Overall, I’d give these 4 stars. They’re inexpensive, safe around food, and catch more than I expected. Just be ready for sticky fingers during setup.

reviews.title: Very worthwhile, effective.
reviews.body: We've used three of them, and they work well in applicable locations. They have little thumb tacks on the lids, so they can be placed almost anywhere. They have no strong smells, so you can place them in high traffic places with no issue. We hang ours on the lids of our ceiling lamps with tape, so they are easy to install almost anywhere, and take up almost no space at all since they are vertical in deployment. We have loose fitting doors, where flies can come into our house easily, but we had over three or four flies hit one of our fresh deployed traps within minutes (like fifteen minutes and there were already four flies experiencing their last [BORING] moments of life). Great buy.

reviews.title: Highly recommended!!!
reviews.body: Absolutely worked 💯 % for the flying insects that were in my house! I tried everything else, including fruit fly/insect containers with apple cider vinegar. The first night that I hung these, in the morning there were at least 30-35 stuck on one strip! I hung up 6 of the 10 and everyone of them caught some! I have no idea where these came from to begin with and since I have a cat, I was afraid of having an extermination done. I had all of my drains closed throughout the house so they weren't originated there. I have no house plants either..the mystery may never be solved. I do believe that when the new company exterminated around our building, they came inside and multiplied...I would have included pics, however they were too disgusting to me!

reviews.author: Gail

reviews.title: Didn't work as well as expected
reviews.body: I bought the Bugbane Fly Strips Indoor Sticky Hanging 24pk with Pins hoping to finally get a handle on the flies that keep showing up in my kitchen.The strips themselves are nicely sticky — they feel super tacky right out of the package and seem like they should grab anything that lands on them. The included thumb tacks are also a nice touch; they’re sturdy and make hanging the strips quick and easy without damaging the ceiling or door frames.Unfortunately, after a full week hanging them in the areas where I see the most flies, they’ve only caught one single fly. Meanwhile I’m still swatting at plenty of others buzzing around. Not sure if the scent or attractant is too weak or if the flies are just avoiding them, but the performance has been pretty disappointing so far.They’re not useless, but they’re definitely not the fly-trapping powerhouse I was expecting. Might work better in a smaller space with fewer flies, but for my situation they only earn 3 stars.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 16, 2026
